# mcp.build

> Hosted, open-source MCP servers for AI agents.

Homepage: https://mcp.build
Repository: https://github.com/hal9ai/mcp.build
Catalog: https://mcp.build/agents.json

## Agents

- **send-email** — https://mcp.build/send-email/ | https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/send-email | Env: GROQ_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY
- **search-web** — https://mcp.build/search-web/ | https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/search-web | Env: EXA_API_KEY
- **fetch-url** — https://mcp.build/fetch-url/ | https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/fetch-url | Env: none
